title: I wanted to love this box!
text: I really wanted to love this subscription box, I even had a messy first box, and the seller immediately took care of the issue. So I decided to keep the subscription going, well box #2 arrived and once again I was super disappointed because they sent a face mask, and it’s considered a full size or deluxe I’m not quite? (Box 2) Solid Day Cream 1.12OZ (full size product) Bali Balm lip Balm(full size) and a essential oil rollerball .27 fl oz (full size) and then my 4th item once again is 1 face mask. I love organic and only use organic beauty products. I understand the costs involved, with that being said, I had to cancel my subscription because I don’t think a face mask should be considered a full size or deluxe product. And if the product page actually said you will receive 3 full size products in every box, I would have been more understanding. But I feel saying 4 full size products is very misleading to the consumer. Yes these products are awesome, I just don’t feel it’s worth my money to get a face mask each month and that be part of the full or deluxe product list. A face masks should be a sample product just thrown in for fun. And the lip balm is awesome but saying it’s worth 30$ is a little ridiculous. Also there were no ingredients listed on the essential oil roller ball, so that was unsuitable for me because I have a few allergies. Just disappointed because this is the only cruelty free, GMO free subscription box I’ve found. I really wanted to love this. 🥺
label: negative
